_help.scenes: Per-scene re-timing, keyed by scene number (scene seconds). Fields: speechStart, speechEnd (the speaking window), pauses [{after: 'phrase', dur: s}], shift (s, moves all captions), chunks [{start, end, lines?}] (one entry per caption chunk, in order; replaces the estimated times).
_help.takes: Per-block camera take offset: {"1": {"offset": 2.4}} = block 1 starts 2.4 s into video/takes/block_1.mp4.
_help.after_recording: Set speechStart/speechEnd from the take (or chunk times from a transcript), and put the measured scene durations into video/timeline/timeline.json.
